verdict.rationale: Oyster is a global employment and payroll platform, so cancelling or correcting a submitted payroll run is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack only claims multi-country payroll in general. It never documents cancelling, reversing, or correcting a submitted payroll before payout, either in the UI or through the API.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can cancel or correct a submitted payroll before employees are paid
